name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_event_handler' = domain; '_31' is the per-event dispatch table index 0x31 (=49 dec), a meaningful domain ID, NOT an address residue: verified (0x51C55 xref-from - 0x51B91 table base) / 4 = 0xC4/4 = 0x31. '__ch22_turn_gated' accurately states chapter 22 + turn-gated cinematic category. No hex address tail anywhere in the name.
purpose: Chapter 22 turn-gated cinematic event handler (dispatch idx 0x31): rotate portrait set, do a 2-corner cursor/window pan, then show dialog page 1 only when the turn counter is exactly 3.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x28) stack-check prologue. Calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(turn_counter signed /2) so the portrait set rotates per invocation. Then fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0x20,0x23) + fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks(8), then fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0,0x23) + fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks(8) (right edge then left edge of row y=0x23, 8 BIOS ticks each). Finally if data_fd2_battle_turn_counter == 3, calls fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=1, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1). Triggered at ch22 turns 3 and 7; the dialog only fires at turn 3 (turn 7 does portrait+pan only). Cyclomatic complexity 1, single conditional. In the binary the dialog call + early return borrow the out-of-line tail of fd2_chapter_event_handler_42__ch28_dialog_only @ 0x359C8 (turn!=3 JNZ 0x35A2E shared RET; turn==3 pushes 8 args then JMP 0x35A20 into shared PUSH current_chapter_text; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene; ADD ESP,0x24; RET) -- a size optimisation equivalent to one self-contained dialog call.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Per-event dispatch-table argument (table signature is 1-arg cdecl void fn(uint)). This handler ignores it ((void)event_arg in src; never read in body).
params.reason: Descriptive of the dispatch-table arg slot; no address residue; conventional name for an ignored dispatch arg. Matches sibling handlers in chevt2.c.

returns.semantics: No return value (cdecl void). Dispatch-table handlers return void.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (0x53bef) -- read twice: signed /2 for portrait index, and == 3 dialog gate
data_fd2_current_chapter_text (0x53a79) -- chapter text buffer pointer passed to fd2_display_dialog_scene (pushed in the borrowed tail at 0x35A20)
notes: All facts cross-checked against live Ghidra: disassembly @ 0x351E9 matches src body 1:1; callee addresses resolve to the named functions (0x10B4E load_portraits, 0x135DD pan, 0x17AA9 wait, 0x36CD7 __CHK, 0x15F84 display_dialog_scene); globals at 0x53BEF/0x53A79 resolve to data_fd2_battle_turn_counter / data_fd2_current_chapter_text; borrowed tail @ 0x359C8 confirmed (JNZ 0x35A2E RET, JMP 0x35A20 shared dialog-call tail, ADD ESP,0x24 = 9*4 args).
